title: Thought for the week
author: Revd Luke
body:
As the season changes and the clocks move it's a good time to reflect on the faithfulness of God through all things. Recents weeks have brought some beautiful moments to celebrate the goodness of God and also tough moments to walk through. The turning of the leaves and fading light remind me of his closeness in all seasons and that his light shines brightest in the dark.

The light shines in the darkness and the darkness has not overcome it.
